name: Glyph Dispatch

checkpoints.task: Payroll batch (east wing): enter a number sequence that uses every digit and the minus, for example 2819-0364-75.
Alarm card (west hall): enter an alert line with ! @ # $ % ^, for example #12! @ops $fee 40% ^up.
Formula wall (north): enter an expression with ( ) * & _ +, for example (a_b+c)*d&e.
Relay desk C: repair one typo with Caps editing, for example pcge to page, with the symbols left as they are.

destinations: Payroll tray in the east wing (digits and minus)
Alarm card in the west hall (six alert glyphs)
Formula wall in the north room (six expression symbols)
Relay desk C (one typo repaired with Caps editing)
medal_rule: clean baseline then personal target, never gates story
map_design_note: The full Systems loop: out of the relay room and down the hub to the east wing, across the hub to the alarm hall, through the maintenance door to the formula room, back over the glass bridge and up the gallery to the relay room. All 23 held-Space outputs are spread over the first three prompts; the last repairs a typo with Caps navigation.
baseline_note: The first clean run records its duration as an untimed baseline and earns the patch and the decoration; an adjustable personal target of about 15% below the clean baseline is offered afterwards, never required.
